description: For startups: say yes to being considered when MaxedS arranges a meeting with an enterprise buyer. Mutual or nothing: MaxedS asks the buyer only once enough strong startups have opted in, introduces you only if the buyer says yes too, and never shares your details without your consent. Use a work email on your company's domain.
